name: AngelList Venture
description: AngelList Venture, renamed AngelList, is a private-markets and fund-administration platform for venture funds, rolling funds, syndicates, SPVs, scout programs, investors, capital calls, compliance, accounting, banking, reporting, and portfolio operations.
agentUseSummary: AngelList publishes no customer-authorized API or hosted MCP contract for its full-service fund platform. A separately operated Investor Management Data Room offers a provider-coordinated API, but its public page supplies no authentication, endpoint, permission, schema, lifecycle, or non-production contract and does not authorize access to venture.angellist.com. Relay therefore mounts no connection or tools.

providerSetup.blocker: AngelList's current full-service help center for venture.angellist.com does not publish an external API or hosted MCP server, customer authorization method, stable origin, least-privilege role or scope model, tools or endpoints and schemas, pagination and rate limits, webhooks, credential rotation and revocation, disconnect semantics, or non-production contract. The separate Investor Management Platform at portal.angellist.com documents only that Data Room customers can email AngelList to discuss an API connection; it publishes none of the required contract details and explicitly distinguishes itself from the full-service platform. Team-member UI permissions, exports, browser sessions, banking instructions, and private endpoints are not acceptable substitutes.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request AngelList login, banking, investor, fund, or Data Room credentials; contact the Data Room API as though it authorized the full-service platform; show Connect; or automate browser and private endpoints. Reconsider AngelList only after it publishes or contractually supplies a distributable full-service customer API or hosted MCP contract with exact account and server origins, authentication, least-privilege permissions, tools or endpoints and schemas, pagination and rate limits, webhook behavior, credential rotation and revocation, disconnect semantics, and non-production test access.

evidence.supports: AngelList states that AngelList Venture was renamed AngelList in 2022 and describes the unified platform for building companies, funds, and investments.
AngelList's current full-service help center covers LP and GP workflows on venture.angellist.com but does not publish a customer API or hosted MCP contract.
AngelList explicitly distinguishes the Investor Management Platform on portal.angellist.com from the full-service LP and GP platform on venture.angellist.com.

The only reviewed current API page asks Data Room customers to email AngelList for guided setup and publishes no endpoint, authentication, permissions, schemas, rate limits, credential lifecycle, disconnect behavior, or non-production contract.

AngelList documents UI team-member permissions spanning account visibility, banking, syndicate settings, deals, LP messaging, and email, reinforcing critical risk without creating an external automation authorization contract.

AngelList's current fund-administration terms govern highly sensitive fund expenses, investment deployments, confidentiality, compliance, and manager responsibilities without supplying a public third-party automation contract.
